title: On Average Modulus of Random Polynomials Over a Unit Circle and Disc
summary: This article presents some interesting and novel results concerning the average modulus of random polynomials on the unit circle and the unit disc, with coefficients distributed as standard normal variates. The paper also introduces new results concerning the bounds of the maximum modulus of random polynomials with coefficients distributed as independently as Gaussian and uniform variates, utilizing probability principles to derive findings about the likelihood of the maximum modulus exceeding a specific threshold, using Markov inequality as the primary probabilistic tool.
